category_title: Preschoolers with aggressive behaviors and social-emotional regulation challenges
minimal_context: The tutor is asking the class to clean up their toys and transition to the rug for the next activity.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: It is time to clean up the toys and transition to the circle rug for our next activity.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: No! I am not cleaning up!

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: We have to transition now. Please put the toys away.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I don't want to! You can't make me go to the rug!

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Joshua, please join the rest of the group.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I'm not going! And if anyone comes over here I'm going to beat them up!

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: It is time to clean up the toys and transition to the circle rug for our next activity.

STUDENT: No! I am not cleaning up!

TUTOR: We have to transition now. Please put the toys away.

STUDENT: I don't want to! You can't make me go to the rug!

TUTOR: Joshua, please join the rest of the group.

STUDENT: I'm not going! And if anyone comes over here I'm going to beat them up!

task.content: Transition times—whether in-between activities, or at the beginning and end of the day

context.time_context: In-between activities, or at the beginning and end of the day
